summary: The reviewed candidates exhibit a high prevalence of confounding and effect modification. Morphological features (lesion size) and liver metastasis status strongly support dual roles. Systemic therapies (line of therapy, lipid-lowering therapy, lisinopril dose) are primarily confounders with moderate evidence for effect modification. Social factors (living situation) are strong confounders, while liver function and lesion presence lacked sufficient evidence to be assigned a role.
